text: Pytest is the most popular testing tool in Python, loved for how little ceremony it needs.
A test is simply a function whose name starts with test — no class or special base required.
[chuckle] And you just use plain assert, with no special methods to memorize — pytest makes the output readable for you.
So checking that add of two and three equals five is one clean, obvious line.
[sniff] To test that code raises an error, you use pytest dot raises inside a with block.
The test passes only if the expected exception actually happens, catching missing error handling.
[sigh] The real magic is parametrize — it runs the same test across many sets of inputs automatically.
One test function, three input rows, becomes three separate checks, keeping your tests compact.
[groan] pytest's simplicity means you'll actually write tests — and well-tested code is code you can trust and change.
